verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז־ חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’ō·w·rî wə·yiš·‘î mim·mî ’î·rā Yah·weh mā·‘ō·wz- ḥay·yay mim·mî ’ep̄·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Of David The LORD is my light and my salvation whom shall I fear The LORD is the stronghold of my life whom shall I dread

verses.original: מְרֵעִים֮ בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י׀ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת־ בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·rê·‘îm biq·rōḇ ‘ā·lay le·’ĕ·ḵōl ’eṯ- bə·śā·rî ṣā·ray wə·’ō·yə·ḇay lî hêm·māh ḵā·šə·lū wə·nā·p̄ā·lū
verses.literal: When the wicked came upon me to devour - my flesh my enemies and foes - stumbled and fell

verses.original: אִם־ מַחֲנֶה֮ תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י׀ לִ֫בִּ֥י לֹֽא־ יִירָ֪א אִם־ מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ma·ḥă·neh ta·ḥă·neh ‘ā·lay lib·bî lō- yî·rā ’im- mil·ḥā·māh bə·zōṯ tā·qūm ‘ā·lay ’ă·nî ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ
verses.literal: Though an army encamps around me my heart {will} not fear though a war . . . breaks out against me I will keep my trust

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת׀ שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־ יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ šā·’al·tî mê·’êṯ- Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯāh ’ă·ḇaq·qêš šiḇ·tî bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yay la·ḥă·zō·wṯ bə·nō·‘am- Yah·weh ū·lə·ḇaq·qêr bə·hê·ḵā·lōw
verses.literal: One thing I have asked . . . of the LORD - this is what I desire to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי׀ בְּסֻכֹּה֮ יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃ בְּ֝צ֗וּר
verses.transliteration: kî bə·yō·wm rā·‘āh yiṣ·pə·nê·nî bə·suk·kōh yas·ti·rê·nî bə·sê·ṯer ’ā·ho·lōw yə·rō·wm·mê·nî bə·ṣūr
verses.literal: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter He will conceal me under the cover of His tent He will set me high upon a rock

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֨ה רֹאשִׁ֡י יָר֪וּם עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh rō·šî yā·rūm ‘al ’ō·yə·ḇay sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯay ḇə·’ā·ho·lōw wə·’ez·bə·ḥāh ziḇ·ḥê ṯə·rū·‘āh ’ā·šî·rāh wa·’ă·zam·mə·rāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy I will sing and make music to the LORD

verses.original: שְׁמַע־ יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.literal: Hear O LORD my voice when I call be merciful and answer me

verses.original: לִ֭בִּי אָמַ֣ר לְךָ֤׀ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî ’ā·mar lə·ḵā baq·qə·šū p̄ā·nāy ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā Yah·weh ’ă·ḇaq·qêš
verses.literal: My heart said Seek His face - Your face O LORD I will seek

verses.original: תַּסְתֵּ֬ר אַל־ פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל־ תַּט־ עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ בְּאַ֗ף הָיִ֑יתָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י אַֽל־ תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל־ תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tas·têr ’al- pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî ’al- taṭ- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā bə·’ap̄ hā·yî·ṯā ‘ez·rā·ṯî ’al- tiṭ·ṭə·šê·nî wə·’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘î
verses.literal: Hide not Your face from me nor turn away Your servant in anger You have been my helper do not leave me or forsake me O God of my salvation

verses.original: כִּי־ אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי׃
verses.literal: Though my father and mother forsake me the LORD will receive me

verses.original: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ יְהוָ֗ה וּ֭נְחֵנִי מִישׁ֑וֹר בְּאֹ֣רַח לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·rê·nî dar·ke·ḵā Yah·weh ū·nə·ḥê·nî mî·šō·wr bə·’ō·raḥ lə·ma·‘an šō·wr·rāy
verses.literal: Teach me Your way O LORD and lead me on a level path because of my oppressors

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י שֶׁ֝֗קֶר עֵֽדֵי־ קָֽמוּ־ בִ֥י וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tə·nê·nî bə·ne·p̄eš ṣā·rāy kî Še·qer ‘ê·ḏê·še- qā·mū- ḇî wî·p̄ê·aḥ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes for false witnesses rise up against me breathing out violence

verses.original: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב־ יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lū·lē he·’ĕ·man·tî lir·’ō·wṯ bə·ṭūḇ- Yah·weh bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living

verses.original: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־ יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaw·wêh ’el- Yah·weh ḥă·zaq wə·ya·’ă·mêṣ lib·be·ḵā wə·qaw·wêh ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Wait patiently for the LORD be strong and courageous . . . Wait patiently for the LORD
